def phase(name, command, cwd, ceiling):
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], cwd=cwd, text=True) == ''
    receipt = {'phase': name, 'command': command, 'cwd': str(cwd), 'whole_wall_ceiling': ceiling,
               'source_commit': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=cwd, text=True).strip(),
               'PYTHONPATH': str(cwd/'src'), 'OMP_NUM_THREADS': '1', 'OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS': '1',
               'started_epoch': time.time()}
    (output/(name+'-command.json')).write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({'phase_start': name, 'whole_wall_ceiling': ceiling}), flush=True)
    started = time.perf_counter()
    failure = None
    with (output/(name+'.stdout.log')).open('x') as stdout, (output/(name+'.stderr.log')).open('x') as stderr:
        process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=cwd,
            env={**os.environ, 'PYTHONPATH': str(cwd/'src'), 'OMP_NUM_THREADS':'1', 'OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS':'1'},
            stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, start_new_session=True)
        while process.poll() is None:
            elapsed = time.perf_counter()-started
            memory = int(Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.current').read_text())
            free = shutil.disk_usage(root).free
            if elapsed >= ceiling:
                failure = 'registered whole phase wall exhausted; no extension'
            elif memory > profile['memory_stop_bytes']:
                failure = 'memory current including file cache>15GiB'
            elif free < profile['disk_min_free_bytes']:
                failure = 'disk free<8GiB'
            publish_progress(status='running', phase=name, phase_elapsed_seconds=elapsed,
                             pid=process.pid, memory_current_bytes=memory, disk_free_bytes=free)
            if failure:
                try:
                    os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                except ProcessLookupError:
                    pass
                try:
                    process.wait(timeout=5)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                    process.wait(timeout=5)
                break
            time.sleep(2)
    receipt.update(returncode=process.returncode, failure=failure,
                   whole_wall_seconds=time.perf_counter()-started, finished_epoch=time.time())
    (output/(name+'-result.json')).write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({'phase_finished': name, 'returncode': process.returncode,
                      'failure': failure, 'whole_wall_seconds': receipt['whole_wall_seconds']}), flush=True)
    if failure or process.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError('phase stopped: '+name)
    return receipt

try:

game_receipts = []
for index, (name, (split, opening, game_index)) in enumerate(sorted(expected.items()), 1):
    if time.perf_counter() - started >= 3600:

    assert job['split'] == split and job['family'] == opening['family'] and job['game'] == game_index
    assert job['opening'] == opening['opening']['moves']
    assert job['max_plies'] == len(job['opening']) + 32
    assert job['actor'] == ('engine-engine' if game_index < 2 else 'neural-engine')
    assert job['neural_color'] == neural_colour(opening['family'], game_index, balanced=True, short_history=True)
    seed = int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(f'20261025:{split}:{opening["family"]}:{game_index}'.encode()).digest()[:8])
    assert job['seed'] == seed and job['label_every_ply'] is True
    assert 'Stockfish 19' in game['engine_id']['name']
    assert game['queries'] == len(game['rows']) > 0
    final_moves = game['final_moves']
    assert final_moves[:len(job['opening'])] == job['opening']
    assert len(final_moves) <= job['max_plies']
    assert len(game['rows']) == len(final_moves) - len(job['opening'])
    board = chess.Board()
    for move in job['opening']:
        board.push_uci(move)
    own_nodes = 0
    for ordinal, row in enumerate(game['rows']):
        ply = len(job['opening']) + ordinal
        assert row['root_fen'] == chess.STARTING_FEN and row['moves'] == final_moves[:ply]
        assert row['fen'] == board.fen() and board.outcome(claim_draw=True) is None
        assert row['split'] == split and row['family'] == opening['family'] and row['game'] == game_index
        key = ' '.join(board.fen().split()[:4])
        assert key == row['position_key']
        keys[split].add(key)
        legal = {move.uci(): move_to_action(board, move) for move in board.legal_moves}
        assert dict(row['legal']) == legal and len(row['legal']) == len(legal)
        references = row['references']
        assert len(references) == min(4, len(legal))
        assert len({r['move'] for r in references}) == len(references)
        assert len({r['depth'] for r in references}) == 1
        assert len({r['actual_query_nodes'] for r in references}) == 1
        assert row['wdl'] == references[0]['wdl']
        masses = soft_policy(references)
        assert len(row['policy']) == len(references)
        for policy, reference, mass in zip(row['policy'], references, masses, strict=True):
            move, action, probability = policy
            assert reference['move'] == move and legal[move] == action
            assert abs(probability - mass) <= 1e-12
            assert reference['budget_nodes'] == 32768 and reference['actual_query_nodes'] > 0
            assert reference['lowerbound'] is False and reference['upperbound'] is False
            assert len(reference['wdl']) == 3 and all(math.isfinite(p) and p >= 0 for p in reference['wdl'])
            assert abs(sum(reference['wdl']) - 1) <= 1e-12
            assert abs(reference['expected_score'] - (reference['wdl'][0] + reference['wdl'][1] / 2)) <= 1e-12
        assert len(row['wdl']) == 3 and all(math.isfinite(p) and p >= 0 for p in row['wdl'])
        assert abs(sum(row['wdl']) - 1) <= 1e-12
        assert abs(sum(p[2] for p in row['policy']) - 1) <= 1e-12
        query_depths[references[0]['depth']] += 1
        own_nodes += references[0]['actual_query_nodes']
        policy_entropy -= sum(p * math.log(p) for p in masses if p)
        wdl_entropy -= sum(p * math.log(p) for p in row['wdl'] if p)
        for label, probability in zip(('win', 'draw', 'loss'), row['wdl'], strict=True):
            wdl_totals[label] += probability
        board.push_uci(final_moves[ply])
    ending = board.outcome(claim_draw=True)
    assert game['actual_nodes'] == own_nodes
    assert game['observed_result'] == (board.result(claim_draw=True) if ending else None)
    assert game['termination'] == (ending.termination.name if ending else 'max_plies')
    if ending:
        terminal_games += 1
    else:
        assert len(final_moves) == job['max_plies']
        capped_games += 1
    nodes += own_nodes
    queries += game['queries']
    rows += len(game['rows'])
    actors[f'{split}:{job["actor"]}:{job["neural_color"]}'] += 1
    endings[game['termination']] += 1
    row_counts[split] += len(game['rows'])
    game_receipts.append({'file': name, 'sha256': manifest['files'][name], 'rows': len(game['rows']), 'actual_nodes': own_nodes, 'queries': game['queries'], 'termination': game['termination']})
    if index % 1000 == 0:
        print(json.dumps({'audited_games': index, 'rows': rows, 'actual_nodes': nodes, 'wall_seconds': time.perf_counter() - started}), flush=True)
